dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minimal; smooth continuous curvature along the lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal area indicating a lack of significant pigmented cover.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light-grey shading concentrated along the posterior dorsal ridge and surrounding the blowhole perimeter.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the white baseline and the faint greyish shaded regions; no sharp pigmented borders observed.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, faint, low-contrast mark mid-dorsally and a subtle linear scrape appearing as a localized pigment disruption.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle topological depression mid-back, causing a shift in specular reflection and minor shadow-casting.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear epidermal marks mid-dorsally, potentially representing healed abrasions or light rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, patent blowhole and a prominent dorsal ridge extending toward the tail peduncle.
